Battery's own case study describes 'Battery's initial acquisition of the Forterro platform via the take-private of Jeeves Information Systems', and the firm's own status field reads 'Majority stake sold to Partners Group in 2022' — selling a majority means holding one. A control acquisition is not a venture entry (T3 addendum), so the row leaves the published base preserved in excluded.csv.

control position: the 2006 Freescale Semiconductor transaction was a $17.6B leveraged buyout that took the company private, led by a consortium (Blackstone, Carlyle, Permira, TPG) in which Battery participated.
